{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique severity values:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Rows with severity == 'severe':", df[df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0])
print("Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999:", df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0])
print("Unique patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check if assay_batch B needs conversion
print("Unique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("Rows with assay_batch == 'B':", df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B'].shape[0])"}
